name: Wacom Pen 2K / LP190K
summary: Wacom Pen 2K / LP190K - LP190K - Accessories & Spare Parts - The Intuos pen works with all Intuos Creative Pen tablets (CTL490, CTH490 and CTH690) and One by Wacom Pen tablets (CTL472 and CTL672). Cordless, battery-free and with 2048 levels of pressur
description_html: The Intuos pen works with all Intuos Creative Pen tablets (CTL490, CTH490 and CTH690) and One by Wacom Pen tablets (CTL472 and CTL672). Cordless, battery-free and with 2048 levels of pressure, it features a programmable side-switch to put shortcuts at your fingertips. Not compatible with older Intuos CTL480, CTH480 and CTH680 models, Intuos 3, 4, 5, Intuos Pro tablets or Cintiq products.
